description: The issue labels every repo starts with. `kinds` says which repos get each label: a product repo runs the pipeline (all three lanes), an infrastructure repo runs the Direct lane only and tracks its debt in issues. `scripts/new-repo.py labels` creates them; `area:<name>` labels are not here because each one belongs to a product-spec file (`docs/product/<name>.md`) and is created with it.

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Adopted, user-visible. Parent of its scenario sub-issues.

labels.name: scenario
labels.description: One action from a feature spec. Closed by the PR that ticks it.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Behaviour that contradicts the product spec.

labels.name: lane:light
labels.description: Triage lane: short spec, one package, no new surface.

labels.name: debt
labels.description: Knowingly left undone or done poorly. States what, why, and the trigger to pay it.

labels.name: decision
labels.description: A question only the owner can answer. Closed by a Decisions entry.

labels.name: idea
labels.description: Not adopted. Body: where it came from, what would make it worth doing.

labels.name: security
labels.description: A finding from a security review.
